title.zh: 规定在卡加延省Abulug市镇设立急诊医院，名称为Abulug急诊医院，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Establishment of An Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Abulug, Province of Cagayan, to Be Known as Abulug Emergency Hospital and Appropriating Funds Therefor.
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Establishment of An Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Abulug, Province of Cagayan, to Be Known as Abulug Emergency Hospital and Appropriating Funds Therefor.

text.en: There shall be established, under the direct supervision of the Director of Medical Services, an emergency hospital in the Municipality of Abulug, Province of Cagayan, to be known as Abulug Emergency Hospital.

The sum of one hundred thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said hospital during the fiscal year nineteen hundred seventy-one. Thereafter, such sums as may be needed for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, June 19, 1971.
